claim: The basic structure: a temporal bandgap is the reversal of a spatial one — the bandgap frequency grows exponentially in time instead of decaying in space; the audio Mathieu resonator above threshold is 'not a metaphor, the same operator'.

pieces.what: An audio resonator whose stiffness is modulated at twice its frequency; depth and rate sliders walk it into the tongue, where noise at the bandgap frequency swells from nothing. Tests 'grows in time' by ear.
pieces.walks_up_from: one resonator ringing with fixed stiffness

pieces.what: Space and time side by side: a wave into a periodic stack decaying with depth, and the same mode in a pumped medium growing with time, on mirrored axes.
Time-reflection vs a reverse buffer: the same phrase through each, to hear whether the open question's distinction is audible.
